name: LilyGO T-Dongle C5 PM2.5 UART 3686 Demo
description: Tests the Adafruit PM2.5 Air Quality Sensor + breadboard adapter kit (PID 3686, PMS5003) read over UART by a LilyGO T-Dongle C5 (ESP32-C5). The device's UART0 pins on the exposed JST/pad port are TX=GPIO11 (D11), RX=GPIO12 (D12) — the same pads the i2c-scan script repurposes for I2C. Responds to checkin, then adds the pm25 UART driver on HardwareSerial. Sensor wiring (3686 adapter rows vcc,gnd,set,rxd,txd,rst): VCC->5V, GND->GND, SET->3V3 (active), RXD->T-Dongle D11 (MCU TX), TXD->T-Dongle D12 (MCU RX), RST->3V3 (out of reset). Uses the migrate-api-v2 (api-v2-pins-as-strings) uart proto shape.

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and board capabilities

steps.name: add-pm25
steps.description: Add the PM2.5 (PMS5003) UART driver on UART0 pads (RX=D12 / TX=D11). Expect periodic Event messages carrying the six PM SI readings.
